string.Data:
UC Music (hereinafter referred to as “the App”) is a mobile application provided by UCWEB, which serves you as a tool for mobile web browsing.

The App provides site search allowing convenient access to your favorite music sites. Unless otherwise indicated, the links to other third party websites contained in the site search are being provided solely as a convenience and UCWEB does not endorse or approve any content or service contained in such websites. UCWEB states that it has no control over these third-party websites or their content or service and does not assume any responsibility or liability for these websites. Further, UCWEB bears no responsibility for the accuracy, legality or content of these third party websites or for that of subsequent links.

UCWEB respects the intellectual property of others and does not permit copyright infringing activities. We may remove any link to any third-party website where the content infringes upon another’s copyright rights, if properly informed according to this Policy.

If you believe that a work has been copied by another party on the website in a way that constitutes copyright infringement of your work, or your intellectual property have been otherwise violated, please notify us in writing of the claimed infringement by providing the following information:

(1) Identification of the links that contains any material that you claim is infringing, and a description of where such material is located on the linked website;

(2) Information reasonably sufficient to prove that the claimed infringing activity exists;

(3) A statement made under penalty of perjury that the information in your notice is accurate and that your are copyright or intellectual property owner or authorized to act on the their behalf;

(4) Information reasonably sufficient to permit UCWEB to contact you, such as an address, telephone number, email address, if available.

The notification of claims of copyright infringement can be filed by “Settings-Feedback”.
